objetivo: diferenciar petequias (planas, de golpe, no se borran con el vaso) y dar la regla: llamar ese mismo día

momentos.p: at a quick glance in the mirror
momentos.porque: 'de un vistazo rápido en el espejo' → una señora apurada mirándose al pasar por el espejo del pasillo
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 66-year-old woman hurrying down a hallway while buttoning a cardigan, glancing sideways at her own reflection in a tall hallway mirror, a car key in her mouth, a coat rack with an umbrella, a small table with mail and a bowl of keys, a runner rug, framed family photos, morning light from the front door glass
momentos.motion: she passes the mirror while fastening the last button

momentos.p: is called petechiae
momentos.porque: 'se llaman petequias' → tobillos con puntitos planos morado-rojizos justo arriba del calcetín
momentos.prompt: close shot of the lower legs and ankles of a 75-year-old woman sitting on a bathroom stool, a white ankle sock pulled down, a sudden cluster of dozens of tiny flat pinpoint purple-red dots on the skin above it, fine veins and dry skin texture, a pale pink bath mat, the edge of a white tub, a plastic cup, soft overhead bathroom light
momentos.motion: her fingers pull the sock down a little further

momentos.p: a little blood has leaked out under the skin
momentos.porque: 'un poquito de sangre salió debajo de la piel' → el antebrazo con puntitos planos, sin relieve
momentos.prompt: close shot of the inner forearm of an older man resting on a white pillow, a scattered patch of tiny flat red and purple pinpoint dots under the skin with no bump at all, the band of a wristwatch, a hospital-style plastic ID bracelet without text, fine hairs, a folded blanket, a bedside table with a water jug, cool daylight
momentos.motion: his wrist turns slowly on the pillow

momentos.p: Now remember the glass.
momentos.porque: 'acordate del vaso' → él levantando el vaso a contraluz
momentos.prompt: standing by the office window holding a clear drinking glass up against the daylight at eye level, looking through it toward the camera with a serious but gentle expression, one eyebrow raised, the window blinds half open, a bookshelf with medical books and a plant, a framed mountain print, a coat on a hook
momentos.motion: he turns the glass so the window light moves through it

momentos.p: They stay exactly the same color.
momentos.porque: 'quedan del mismo color' → el vaso apretado contra la canilla y los puntitos siguen igual
momentos.prompt: close shot looking down through the round bottom of a clear drinking glass pressed firmly against the shin of an older woman, the tiny flat purple-red pinpoint dots under the glass still exactly as dark and visible as the ones around it while the surrounding skin whitens under pressure, her fingers holding the glass, a pajama pant leg rolled up, a bedspread under her leg, lamp light
momentos.motion: the glass presses down harder and the dots underneath do not change

momentos.p: like hard coughing or straining
momentos.porque: 'tos fuerte o hacer fuerza' → un señor tosiendo en el sillón
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 69-year-old man in a flannel shirt coughing hard into his elbow while sitting on a recliner with a blanket over his knees, eyes squeezed shut and face flushed, a box of tissues, a mug of honey tea, a humidifier puffing mist, a TV remote, a side lamp, a window with grey rainy light
momentos.motion: his shoulders jerk with the cough and the humidifier mist drifts

momentos.p: sometimes with blood thinners and other medicines
momentos.porque: 'anticoagulantes y otros remedios' → el pastillero de la mañana con varios frascos
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a morning kitchen counter with a large weekly pill organizer opened at Monday, several orange prescription bottles without readable labels, a glass of water, a half-eaten slice of toast, an older woman's hand dropping a small white pill into her palm, a coffee maker, a radio, a window with sunrise light
momentos.motion: a pill drops into her palm and she closes her hand

momentos.p: call your doctor that same day
momentos.porque: 'llamá al médico ese mismo día' → él atendiendo el teléfono del consultorio con urgencia serena
momentos.prompt: standing at his desk holding the handset of an office phone to his ear, pen in the other hand writing on a notepad, focused and serious with a calm steady look, a computer monitor turned away, a stethoscope around his neck, a stack of charts, a wall clock, a bookshelf with a plant, daylight
momentos.motion: he writes a quick note while listening and nods

momentos.p: with a fever, with feeling very sick
momentos.porque: 'con fiebre, sintiéndose muy mal' → una señora en la cama con termómetro
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a pale 73-year-old woman lying in bed under a quilt with a digital thermometer in her mouth, damp hair on the pillow, eyes half closed and weary, a husband's hand holding a glass of water toward her, a box of tissues, a lamp, pill bottles on the nightstand, curtains drawn with dim grey light
momentos.motion: her eyes open slowly and the hand brings the glass closer

momentos.p: with new bruises you can't explain
momentos.porque: 'moretones nuevos que no te explicás' → la mujer descubriendo un moretón en el brazo
momentos.prompt: close shot of the upper arm of an older woman pushing up the sleeve of her nightgown and discovering a large purple-blue bruise she cannot explain, her fingertips touching its edge, a few tiny dots near it, a dresser edge, a hairbrush, soft morning bedroom light
momentos.motion: her fingers press lightly around the bruise

momentos.p: with bleeding gums or nosebleeds
momentos.porque: 'encías que sangran o nariz' → el cepillo con espuma rosada en la pileta
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a bathroom sink with a toothbrush lying on the edge covered in pink-tinged foam, a crumpled tissue with a small red spot, a cup, a tube of toothpaste, an older man's hand turning on the faucet, chrome fixtures, white tiles, a small window with frosted glass and morning light
momentos.motion: water starts to run from the faucet into the sink

momentos.p: Get seen right away.
momentos.porque: 'que te vean ya' → una pareja mayor entrando apurada a la guardia de noche
momentos.prompt: wide shot at night of an older husband helping his wife walk quickly toward the lit sliding glass doors of a hospital emergency entrance, his arm around her back, her coat over her nightgown, a parked car with its door still open, a wheelchair by the entrance, a red emergency light glow, wet pavement reflecting the lights
momentos.motion: the sliding doors open and they step toward them

componentes.p: Cherry angiomas show up one by one
componentes.title: Slow vs. sudden

componentes.p: When you press a clear glass on petechiae
If a crop of tiny flat red or purple dots appears suddenly
componentes.title: SUDDEN + DOESN'T FADE = CALL TODAY

componentes.p: That is your body asking for help.
The first one, and the most important one, is called petechiae.
componentes.title: Red dots that aren't cherries

componentes.p: And if those dots come with a fever

objetivo: escena concreta que enseña el vaso: los puntos nuevos eran distintos, llamó esa noche, se salvó por conocer su piel

momentos.p: a retired school librarian
momentos.porque: 'bibliotecaria jubilada' → Ruth entre estantes, ordenando libros como voluntaria
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair, cat-eye reading glasses on a beaded chain and a lavender cardigan, shelving books in a small-town public library as a volunteer, smiling to herself, a wooden book cart, a globe on a table, a reading lamp with a green shade, tall oak shelves, warm afternoon light through tall windows
momentos.motion: she slides a book into place on the shelf and straightens the row

momentos.p: dozens of little red dots on her chest
momentos.porque: 'decenas de puntitos en el pecho que nunca le molestaron' → Ruth tranquila en su jardín con escote en V
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair and cat-eye glasses on a beaded chain, wearing a V-neck cotton blouse that shows many small red dots across her upper chest, cutting roses in her backyard with pruning shears, relaxed and content, a wicker basket of roses, a watering can, a birdbath, a white picket fence, morning sun
momentos.motion: she snips a rose and lays it in the basket

momentos.p: getting ready for bed, she noticed new tiny dots on both shins
momentos.porque: 'preparándose para dormir vio puntitos nuevos en las canillas' → Ruth en el borde de la cama, sorprendida
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair, in a pale blue flannel pajama set with the pant legs pulled up, sitting on the edge of her bed at night and staring down at both shins sprinkled with tiny flat red dots, her eyebrows lifted and mouth slightly open in surprise, cat-eye glasses on a beaded chain, a bedside lamp, a library book and a cup of cocoa on the nightstand, a cat curled on the quilt
momentos.motion: she leans closer to her shin and the cat lifts its head

momentos.p: like someone had sprinkled red pepper on her skin
momentos.porque: 'como si le hubieran espolvoreado pimienta roja' → la canilla y el pimentero al lado
momentos.prompt: close shot of an older woman's shin covered with a fine sprinkle of tiny flat red pinpoint dots that look like crushed red pepper flakes, and next to her leg on the quilt a small glass shaker of red pepper flakes she brought from the kitchen to compare, the cuff of blue flannel pajamas, a warm bedside lamp glow
momentos.motion: the pepper shaker tips over slightly and a few flakes spill onto the quilt

momentos.p: She also had a bruise on her arm she didn't remember getting.
momentos.porque: 'también un moretón que no recordaba' → Ruth mirando un moretón en el brazo, confundida
momentos.prompt: close-medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair and cat-eye glasses, rolling up the sleeve of her blue pajama top and looking puzzled at a large purple bruise on her upper arm, her head tilted and lips pursed as she tries to remember, a lamp behind her, a framed wedding photo on the dresser, night window
momentos.motion: she turns her arm toward the lamp and frowns

momentos.p: it's just more of my red spots
momentos.porque: 'son más de mis puntitos' → Ruth quitándole importancia, estirando la mano a la lámpara
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair, in blue flannel pajamas, waving her hand dismissively with a tired little smile as she reaches with the other hand for the switch of her bedside lamp, the cat stretching on the quilt, a library book with a bookmark, a cup of cocoa, a clock on the nightstand showing ten
momentos.motion: she waves her hand and reaches toward the lamp switch

momentos.p: But she remembered her spots were round, raised
momentos.porque: 'recordó que los suyos eran redondos y en relieve' → Ruth se frena frente al espejo del ropero y compara
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair, standing still in front of her wardrobe mirror in blue pajamas, pulling the collar down to look at the round raised red dots on her chest and then glancing down at her shins, her expression changing to a serious, focused frown, the wardrobe door open with cardigans on hangers, a lamp, a quilt behind her
momentos.motion: she pulls her collar down and looks from her chest to her legs

momentos.p: So she pressed a glass on her leg, and the dots didn't fade.
momentos.porque: 'apretó un vaso contra la pierna y no se borraron' → Ruth haciendo la prueba sobre la cama
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair and cat-eye glasses, sitting on her bed pressing the bottom of a clear kitchen drinking glass firmly against her shin, leaning over to look through it, her face tense and focused, a lamp on, the cat watching from the pillow, a cup of cocoa, a library book, night outside the window
momentos.motion: she presses the glass down and leans closer to look through it

momentos.p: She called the after-hours line that night.
momentos.porque: 'llamó a la guardia esa misma noche' → Ruth en la cocina a oscuras con el teléfono
momentos.prompt: medium shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair in blue pajamas and a knitted shawl, standing in her dim kitchen at night holding a cordless phone to her ear, her other hand on the counter, alert and determined, only the light over the stove on, a kettle, a calendar on the wall, a clock showing twenty past ten, a dark window
momentos.motion: she turns toward the counter while speaking on the phone

momentos.p: one of her medications had dropped her platelets
momentos.porque: 'uno de sus remedios le había bajado las plaquetas' → el médico de guardia revisando sus frascos con ella
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a young female doctor in a hospital consultation booth holding up one orange prescription bottle and pointing at it while Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair and cat-eye glasses, listens and nods with relief beginning on her face, several pill bottles lined up on the small table, a blood pressure monitor, a curtain, fluorescent light
momentos.motion: the doctor sets the bottle down and Ruth nods

momentos.p: They changed it, and she was fine.
momentos.porque: 'se lo cambiaron y quedó bien' → Ruth de vuelta en su jardín, sonriendo, días después
momentos.prompt: wide shot of Ruth, a 74-year-old woman with short silver hair in a sun hat and a lavender cardigan, watering her flower beds with a green hose in her sunny backyard, smiling and humming, her cat on the steps, a birdbath, roses along the white picket fence, laundry on a line, bright morning light
momentos.motion: the water arcs from the hose onto the flowers

momentos.p: If she had waited until her yearly checkup
momentos.porque: 'si hubiera esperado al control anual' → él serio mirando una historia clínica, pensativo
momentos.prompt: sitting at his desk looking down at an open paper patient chart, his reading glasses in one hand and his other hand rubbing his chin, a grave thoughtful expression with lips pressed together, a wall calendar, a stethoscope on the desk, a desk lamp, a mug, bookshelf and plant behind, late afternoon light
momentos.motion: he lowers the glasses slowly and looks up

componentes.caption: so she called that same night
